Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of Work On-site Calibration of Megger Make Transformer Oil BDV Tester through OE M, Model No. OTS100AF/2 1. On-site Calibration: Calibration of the Megger make Transformer Oil Breakdown Voltage (BDV) Tester, Model No. OTS100AF/2, installed at CTPS, DVC, through the Ori ginal Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or its authorized service representative. 2. Inspection and Functional Verification: Inspection of the instrument, electrod es, test vessel, electrical connections and associated components to verify proper fu nctioning before calibration. 3. Calibration under NABL Scope: Calibration of the instrument using suitable trac eable reference standards, under the applicable NABL-accredited scope, as per the m anufacturer's recommendations and relevant technical requirements. 4. Performance Verification: Verification of the instrument's measurement accura cy, test voltage generation, operational controls and other applicable parameters as per the manufacturer's specifications. 5. Calibration Certificate: Submission of a duly signed calibration certificate indica ting the calibration results, observed deviations, measurement uncertainty, traceabili ty details and recommended calibration due date, as applicable. 6. Technical Discussion: Discussion with the concerned departmental personnel re garding calibration results, instrument performance, operating precautions and main tenance requirements. 7. Training-cum-Redemonstration: Providing on-site refresher training and redem onstration to departmental personnel on the correct operation of the BDV tester, sam ple preparation, testing procedure and interpretation of results. 8. Final Functional Demonstration: Demonstration of satisfactory operation of th e instrument after completion of calibration and submission of the relevant service re port. 9. Service Report: Submission of a detailed service report covering inspection, cali
bration, observations, results and recommendations, along with details of any deficie ncies noticed during the service. .
